column1: # Turkish (tr) catalog. Same format as `es.tsv`: context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Turkish video-editing vocabulary. No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI
# was consulted or copied; add entries the same way. Product, format and feature names (FilmCraft,
# ArtCraft, Lumetri, Essential Graphics, Essential Sound, AAF, EDL, FCPXML, OMF, OpenTimelineIO…)
# keep their spelling. This catalog covers every menu; anything else is shown in English.
# Terms: track = kanal, bin = kutu, marker = işaretçi, playhead = oynatma imleci, In/Out = giriş/çıkış,
# transition = geçiş, frame hold = sabit kare, panel = panel, workspace = çalışma alanı, sequence =
# sekans, timeline = zaman çizelgesi, clip = klip, render = işleme, export = dışa aktar, proxy =
# vekil dosya, caption = altyazı, transcript = yazı dökümü, guide = kılavuz çizgisi, snap = tutundur,
# ripple = dalgalı, metadata = üst veri. View = Görünüm, Appearance = Görünüş (ayrı sözcükler).
# Commands use the infinitive ("Projeyi Aç…", "Kanal Ekle…") and address the reader with the
# imperative ("Kaydet"). A trailing "…" is kept from the English source.
